en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the city of Clermont‑Ferrand from a high terrace or balcony. In the foreground are three people in early 20th‑century clothing standing by a balustrade, looking out over the city. A tall religious statue rises from the balustrade. Below stretches the town with dense rooftops and a prominent church spire, with hills and mountains of Auvergne in the background. Printed French text at the top identifies the scene and location.
